description: Plain-language explanation of an EVM or NEAR transaction: status, method, native and token transfers, approvals (unlimited ones flagged), fee, and a risk verdict for each counterparty, with a one-line summary. Covers Base, Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Base Sepolia and NEAR. Useful to check what a payment or approval really did. Price: $0.04 USDC per call (x402).

chain.description: ethereum, base, base-sepolia, optimism, arbitrum, near or near-testnet

sender.description: NEAR only: the signer account; required on near-testnet, optional on mainnet

name: screen_transaction
title: Transaction screening
